observations: Three photos show a truck trailer with a corrugated metal body, likely a flatbed or tipper type.
The trailer is heavily rusted and dirty, with visible corrosion on the side panels and frame.
Multiple spare tires are stacked on the ground beside the trailer.
The trailer appears to be detached from a cab, with no engine or front section visible.
The rear of the trailer is shown in photo 2, with a wooden or metal tailgate and visible mud and grime.
No brand, model, or VIN is visible on any part of the trailer in the photos.
The seller's text mentions 'good body with good axil', but no axles are clearly visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows extensive rust and corrosion on the side panels, contradicting 'good body'.
No axles are clearly visible in any photo; the seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.
No evidence of functionality or working condition is shown; the trailer appears to be in poor physical condition.

risks.risk: Structural damage or rust compromising safety and load capacity
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the trailer's frame, side rails, and floor, showing depth of rust and any cracks or bends.
risks.if_unproven: priced as structurally compromised and unsafe for use

risks.risk: Axles or suspension system in poor condition or non-functional
risks.proof: Photos of the axle(s), wheels, and suspension components from multiple angles, including underside view.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or requiring major repairs

risks.risk: Missing or damaged components (e.g., lights, brakes, coupling, tailgate mechanism)
risks.proof: Photos of the front coupling, rear lights, brake lines, and tailgate operation.

proof_requests: Photos of the axles and suspension system from the underside.
Close-up photos of the trailer frame and side rails to assess rust depth.
Photos of the front coupling and rear lights/brakes.
Video or photo showing the tailgate operation and any other moving parts.
response.reason: The trailer's condition cannot be accurately assessed without clearer views of critical components like axles, frame integrity, and safety systems. The seller's claims of 'good body' and 'good axil' are contradicted or unverifiable from current photos, and hidden risks related to structural integrity and functionality must be resolved before pricing.
